visual_decomposition.original_layout: Two upper boxes separately summarize cohorts and outcomes; a wide lower panel places three evaluation designs side by side. Blue highlights identify AI/flow, gray text describes shared study facts; flags serve country labels, not validation evidence.
visual_decomposition.connections: Shared case imagery branches to AI and clinician reads; bidirectional comparison joins their decisions. UK-to-US arrow denotes a model/data transfer evaluation. Case image fans out to six reader labels. None is a training-label feedback loop.
visual_decomposition.why_effective: Separates the who/when questions from which evaluation is performed, and puts alternative experiments in parallel.
visual_decomposition.limitations: Figure1 omits detailed split counts, reader-availability denominators and500→465 exclusions; symbolicT−delta does not explain every negative-eligibility condition. Original mammogram pixels are unnecessary for the transferred design diagram.
visual_decomposition.transfer_plan: Retain cohort/outcome/evaluation separation; replace decorative flags and mammograms with editable labeled study units; use explicit source-backed N at each stage.

known_conflicts_and_gaps: MainUK exclusion count5990 of31766 does not reconcile with final25856; S1 implies5910. Do not assert a correction.
No exact final US train/validation patient or image counts in inspected sources.
UK-only variant checkpoint/threshold validation and auxiliaryCBIS-DDSM provenance are not fully specified.
Raw patient assignment overlap was not independently checked; source/test sites and dates overlap.
UKtune is the supplement label; do not swap counts or claim complete mapping of everytune record to every validation operation.
transferable_rules: Attach N to stage, unit and comparator availability.
Keep patient allocation separate from within-patient case selection.
Do not convert repeated readers to independent patient counts.
Distinguish positive outcome windows from population-specific negative follow-up eligibility.
Keep source-reported test withholding distinct from a verified leakage audit.
Preserve source arithmetic conflicts without fabricating a complete balanced exclusion flow.
nontransferable: All particular counts, fractions, dates, follow-up windows and source sites.
Any clinical benefit or prospective/temporal/site-held-out validation claim.
The full model-development pipeline, training recipe or exact variant-specific validation process.
distribution: Original PDF/text/crops remain local-only. Distribute original redraw, source links, typed facts and analytical notes only.
